data: In the Antonym Negation task, does the model performance of ROBERTA-L increase as the number of training examples increases?

In this subfigure, the line representing ROBERTA-L is shown alongside the NO LANG. control and baseline model. The x-axis represents the number of training examples, and the y-axis represents the model performance.

By analyzing the graph, we can observe that the ROBERTA-L line consistently increases as the number of training examples increases. This indicates that the model performance of ROBERTA-L improves with more training data.
